root_cause: The deployed V18 website shell displayed a yellow three-bar brand icon indistinguishable from a separate hamburger control. Unbounded mobile hero headline and yellow marker background impaired readability; a timed fixed .bgx-lek popup obscured the primary content and CTA. The generated shell is not equivalent to the repository's legacy index.html.
prevention_rule: Apply responsive first-fold styles to the generated V18 shell from one shared, cache-versioned stylesheet; keep one accessible mobile nav trigger, readable responsive type, an unobscured highlight and no timed overlay covering mobile CTAs. Guard changes with a site-shell lane test and protected CI.

test_evidence.status: Test source committed; protected CI and production visual readback pending.

outcome.implementation: Mobile first-fold shared style correction in PR #4390
